source_input:
Business name: Cornhead Bagel
Selected business type: Café
Business description / notes: Currency:
USD
Cornhead is a bagel shop. Last month revenue was $100,000 and total operating costs were $95,800. Known cost items: labor $34,000; ingredients $18,000; rent and utilities $12,500; delivery platform fees $9,300. Remaining operating costs were not itemized.
Tuesday evenings from 6 PM to 10 PM average only $1,900 in monthly sales, but staffing during those hours costs $3,080 per month. Staffing levels are similar to Friday evenings, even though Friday evening sales are much higher.
Delivery orders average $18.40 in revenue per order. For some delivery orders, platform fees, packaging, discounts, and food costs together exceed the revenue from the order. Exact loss per order is not yet available.
Ingredient waste last month was 9% of ingredient purchases. The business's stated internal target is 5%.
Rent and utilities total $12,500. No information is available showing whether this amount is above or below market rates.
Labor is the largest known cost category at $34,000.
Tuesday evening 6 PM to 10 PM headcount may be tested by reducing headcount by 1 person.
Waste rate may be tested from the current 9% toward the stated 5% target.
No controllable delivery decision variable or intervention lever has been supplied.
